# CosmoShip

> A community library for sharing, searching, and downloading ship designs for Cosmoteer: Starship Architect & Commander. Browse over 2,000 player-created ships, curate collections, and join multiplayer tournaments.

## Pages

- [Browse ships](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/?order=new&page=1): Search and filter the full ship library by name, faction, size, cost, and more.
- [Collections](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/collections): Player-curated sets of ships grouped by theme, faction, or strategy.
- [Games](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/games): Community tournaments and multiplayer matches with bracket support.
- [Upload](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/upload): Share your own ship design with the community.
- [About CosmoShip](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/about): Background on the project and how to contribute.
- [About Cosmoteer](https://cosmoship.duckdns.org/about-game): Overview of the game, links to official resources and wiki.
